regime: Energy-led inflation + near-5% US 10Y + elevated CCC stress, with Friday oil relief showing de-escalation sensitivity. August CPI was +0.4% m/m and +3.4% y/y; core +0.3% m/m. Physical AI/power demand remains strong, but LNG security, funding quality, real yields and input costs dominate selection.

channels.label: Growth / Demand
channels.interpretation: August PPI and prior ISM show continued activity, but $100+ oil is a growing drag on real demand.

channels.label: Policy Relief
channels.interpretation: August CPI and PPI plus $100+ oil make policy relief scarce; September hike odds are roughly 85-90%.

channels.label: Financial Conditions
channels.interpretation: The US 10Y briefly approached 5%, preserving a high hurdle rate for long-duration, leveraged and pre-commercial equities.

channels.label: Broad Credit
channels.regime: Quality credit open; marginal funding cost rising
channels.interpretation: Risk-free rates and AI/capex issuance raise funding hurdles even for strong issuers.

channels.label: Weak-End Credit Stress
channels.interpretation: ICE BofA CCC & lower yield to worst reached 15.17% on Sep 9.

channels.label: Consumer
channels.interpretation: Michigan sentiment fell to 47.8 while one-year inflation expectations rose to 4.6%; energy and financing costs pressure discretionary demand.

channels.label: Housing
channels.interpretation: Near-5% long Treasury yields keep housing financing restrictive.

channels.label: Industrial / AI / Power Capex
channels.regime: Physical power/AI capex still strong but costlier
channels.interpretation: Fresh Nvidia Australia 2GW plan and existing EIA/ISM evidence confirm demand, while financing and permitting quality matter more.

channels.label: Input Costs
channels.interpretation: PPI goods +1.1% m/m, oil above $100, and electrical/copper constraints keep input pressure extreme.

channels.label: Labour
channels.regime: Labour resilient but mixed beneath headline growth
channels.interpretation: Recent payrolls were firm, while ISM services employment remains contractionary.

channels.label: Risk Appetite
channels.interpretation: US equities rebounded >0.8% Friday with positive breadth as oil fell, but major indices and Russell 2000 still finished the week lower.

channels.label: Crude
channels.regime: Acute physical risk with de-escalation sensitivity
channels.interpretation: Brent stayed above $100 after briefly nearing $110; Gulf/Bab el-Mandeb disruptions remain physical, but diplomatic headlines can produce sharp retracements.

channels.label: Refined Products
channels.interpretation: Shipping insurance and route disruption amplify already-tight product markets and freight costs.

channels.label: US Gas
channels.regime: US gas well supplied; global LNG scarcity severe
channels.interpretation: US storage is comfortable, but QatarEnergy is seeking multi-year US LNG supply through 2031 after major Gulf LNG capacity damage.

channels.label: Gold / Monetary Hedge
channels.regime: Structural hedge intact; tactical real-yield pressure
channels.interpretation: Gold fell sharply as Fed hike odds and Treasury yields rose despite geopolitical stress.

channels.label: Copper / Industrial Metals
channels.regime: Structural grid demand, tactical tariff-distortion unwind
channels.interpretation: Grid demand remains strong, but the sharp FCX/copper reversal after tariff-delay reports confirms that inventory/policy distortion amplified the prior squeeze.

channels.label: Battery Storage / Lithium
channels.interpretation: Peak-load and grid needs support deployment while excess manufacturing keeps commodity cell/lithium economics selective.

channels.label: Agriculture / Fertilizer Inputs
channels.interpretation: Feedstock, freight and weather pressure support nitrogen/seed pricing but squeeze farm affordability.

channels.label: Equity Breadth
channels.interpretation: 383 S&P 500 names declined Sep 9; NYSE and Nasdaq breadth were strongly negative and the Russell 2000 is below its 50-day average. Diagnostic only: no automatic stock-score effect yet.

channels.label: Earnings Support
channels.interpretation: FactSet shows Q3 bottom-up EPS estimates rose 1.2% through July-August instead of the normal early-quarter decline. This is the main counterweight to weak breadth. Diagnostic only.

channels.label: AI Funding Quality
channels.regime: AI demand strong; capital burden rising
channels.interpretation: Oracle negative FCF and large funding needs, Z.AI's $5bn raise and prospective mega-IPOs reinforce capital intensity as a first-order AI filter.

channels.label: Global LNG Availability
channels.interpretation: Qatar's damaged capacity and long replacement horizon force Europe/Asia buyers toward US and other alternative LNG supply.
